_comment: Web control panel settings. Copy to settings.json. `nhub setup` writes the argon2id hash below and `nhub reset password` replaces it; the plaintext is never stored.
_comment_agent: The TLS port the /api/agent routes answer on, pinned by the fingerprint in every enrollment link.
_comment_client: Path to the neutrino_client tarball offered to LAN devices for one-click install. Build it in the neutrino_client repo and drop it in config/devices/packages/.
_comment_remote_desktop: Where the Devices tab downloads AnyDesk/ToDesk from. These vendor URLs change with each release; update them here if an install reports the download is not a Debian package. Omit the block to use the built-in defaults.
